sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Third Amendment Ordinance 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE III OF 2010
ORDINANCE III OF 2010
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (THIRD
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2010
An Ordinance further to amend the Sindh
Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
22nd March, 2010]
No. S. Legis: 1(3)/2010, dated 22-3-2010.---The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient further to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the
Provincial Assembly is not in session and the Governor of Sindh
is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take
immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:--
1. Short title
and commencement.--(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Sindh Local Government
(Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Amendment in section 179-A of Sindh Ordinance No.XXVII of 2001

ORDINANCE III OF 2010
ORDINANCE III OF 2010
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (THIRD
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2010
An Ordinance further to amend the Sindh
Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
22nd March, 2010]
No. S. Legis: 1(3)/2010, dated 22-3-2010.---The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient further to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the
Provincial Assembly is not in session and the Governor of Sindh
is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take
immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:--
2. Amendment in
section 179-A of Sindh Ordinance No.XXVII
of 2001.---In the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
in section 179-A---
(I) In subsection (3), after the words "Local Governments",
the words "and Councils' shall be added;
(II) in subsection (5), for clauses (a) and (b), the following
shall be substituted:--
(a) on dissolution of the Local Governments and councils, the government
shall, within seventy five days, request the Chief Election Commissioner, for
holding the elections of the Local Governments.
(b) The elections
of the Local Governments shall be conducted under this amendment or new
enactment. In case, any new law is not passed, the elections shall be conducted
under this amendment. In any case, the Government shall ensure elections within
165 days within the scope of clause (a) above.
